name: aracommit
description: ARACommit helps generate conventional commit messages from staged Git changes using AI.
author: Funara (ARA AI Ecosystem)

virtualWorkspaces.description: ARACommit requires a local git repository to read diffs and create commits.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: ARACommit generates commit messages from diffs in any workspace, but auto-commit and auto-push are disabled in untrusted workspaces.

enumDescriptions: ARA Assistant automatic free model routing (no API key required)
Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp, Together, Fireworks, etc.)
DeepSeek (works without VPN in restricted regions)
OpenRouter (300+ models via single API key, includes free models)
aracommit.provider.type.description: Select the AI provider for commit message generation

enumDescriptions: Custom language — specify the language name in the 'Custom Language Name' setting below
aracommit.commit.commitLanguage.markdownDescription: Language for generated commit messages. Some commit formats may have limited support for non-English languages — pick `custom` and set `#aracommit.commit.customLanguageName#` for any language not listed.

aracommit.commit.customLanguageName.markdownDescription: Language name to use when `custom` is selected as the commit language (e.g. *Ukrainian*, *Italian*, *Arabic*). The format template will be translated via LLM and cached in `.aracommit/translations.json`.

aracommit.commit.commitFormat.markdownDescription: Format style for generated commit messages. Choose Conventional or Gitmoji Conventional.

aracommit.commit.useCustomInstructions.markdownDescription: Use custom instructions for commit message generation. **When enabled, `#aracommit.commit.customInstructions#` must not be empty.**

aracommit.commit.customInstructions.markdownDescription: Custom instructions for commit message generation. Required when `#aracommit.commit.useCustomInstructions#` is enabled.

aracommit.commit.commitlint.enabled.markdownDescription: Validate the generated message against the selected Conventional or Gitmoji Conventional format, auto-fix mechanical violations and retry with the LLM when needed (up to `#aracommit.commit.commitlint.maxRetries#` times).

aracommit.commit.commitlint.maxRetries.markdownDescription: Maximum number of validation+refinement cycles when `#aracommit.commit.commitlint.enabled#` is on.

aracommit.commit.commitlint.rulesPath.markdownDescription: Custom path to the commitlint rules file (e.g. `./config/commitlint.config.js`). Used by the Conventional format. Leave empty to auto-discover `commitlint.config.{js,cjs,json,yml,yaml}` in the repository root.

enumDescriptions: The bundled static validator with per-format rule sets (no project code is executed).
The repo's own commitlint CLI from node_modules — exact parity with CI (presets, extends chains, plugins). Falls back to builtin when unavailable. Applies to Conventional format only.
aracommit.commit.commitlint.engine.markdownDescription: Which engine validates generated messages when `#aracommit.commit.commitlint.enabled#` is on.

aracommit.commit.autoCommit.markdownDescription: Automatically commit the staged changes after generating the message.

aracommit.commit.autoPush.markdownDescription: Automatically push changes after committing. **Requires `#aracommit.commit.autoCommit#` to be enabled — ignored otherwise.**

aracommit.gemini.model.markdownDescription: Gemini model for commit message generation. The default is `gemini-3-8-flash`; use `auto` to try all available models in quality order. The canonical UI is the [ARACommit sidebar](command:aracommit.settings.focus): it fetches Google's live model list and updates this setting on selection. Only used when Gemini provider is selected.

aracommit.openai.model.markdownDescription: OpenAI model for commit message generation. The canonical UI is the [ARACommit sidebar](command:aracommit.settings.focus) — it fetches OpenAI's live model list (filtered to chat-capable families) and updates this setting on selection. Only used when OpenAI provider is selected.

aracommit.openai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for OpenAI API. Change only if using Azure OpenAI or a custom endpoint. Default: <https://api.openai.com/v1>

aracommit.ollama.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for Ollama API. Only used when Ollama provider is selected. Default: <http://localhost:11434>

aracommit.ollama.model.markdownDescription: Ollama model name. The canonical UI is the [ARACommit sidebar](command:aracommit.settings.focus) — it fetches the live list from `/api/tags`. Make sure the model is installed locally. Only used when Ollama provider is selected.

aracommit.ollama.useAuthToken.description: Enable authentication token for Ollama API. Enable this if your Ollama instance requires an auth token

aracommit.ollama.numCtx.markdownDescription: Context window length passed to Ollama as `options.num_ctx`. **`0` (default) leaves the per-model Ollama default in place** — set explicitly only if your model's default is too small for your diffs (e.g. `8192`, `16384`, `32768`). Larger values use more RAM/VRAM.

aracommit.openrouter.model.markdownDescription: OpenRouter model ID (e.g. `meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free`, `anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5`, `deepseek/deepseek-chat`). The canonical UI is the [ARACommit sidebar](command:aracommit.settings.focus) — it fetches OpenRouter's live model list. Only used when OpenRouter provider is selected.

aracommit.openrouter.preferFreeModels.markdownDescription: Filter the OpenRouter model picker to free models only (models with `:free` suffix or zero pricing). Default: show all 300+ models (free + paid). Enable to narrow the picker to free-tier only.

aracommit.anthropic.model.markdownDescription: Anthropic model ID (e.g. `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, `claude-opus-4-1-20250805`). See <https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models> for the current list. Only used when Anthropic provider is selected.

aracommit.deepseek.model.markdownDescription: DeepSeek model ID (e.g. `deepseek-v4-1-flash`, `deepseek-chat`, `deepseek-reasoner`). The canonical UI is the [ARACommit sidebar](command:aracommit.settings.focus) — it fetches DeepSeek's live model list. Only used when DeepSeek provider is selected.

aracommit.xai.model.markdownDescription: xAI Grok model ID (e.g. `grok-4-7`, `grok-3-mini`, `grok-3`, `grok-4-fast`, `grok-4-1-fast`, `grok-code-fast-1`). The canonical UI is the [ARACommit sidebar](command:aracommit.settings.focus) — it falls back to a static list if `/v1/models` is blocked (e.g. on fresh xAI accounts without credits). Only used when xAI provider is selected.

aracommit.custom.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible `chat/completions` endpoint. Examples: `http://localhost:1234/v1` (LM Studio), `http://localhost:8000/v1` (vLLM), `http://localhost:8080/v1` (llama.cpp server), `http://localhost:8080/v1` (LocalAI), `https://api.together.xyz/v1` (Together AI), `https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1` (Fireworks). Only used when Custom provider is selected.

aracommit.custom.model.markdownDescription: Model ID to send to the Custom endpoint. Only used when Custom provider is selected.

aracommit.custom.useApiKey.markdownDescription: Send an API key to the Custom endpoint. Disable for self-hosted servers that don't require auth (LM Studio, llama.cpp server default). When enabled, set the key via the `ARACommit: Set Custom API Key` command.

aracommit.custom.chatCompletionsPath.markdownDescription: Path appended to `#aracommit.custom.baseUrl#` for chat completion requests. Default is `/chat/completions` — change only if your server uses a non-standard path.

aracommit.general.temperature.markdownDescription: LLM sampling temperature applied to all providers. Lower (e.g. `0.2`) = more deterministic / repeatable commit messages; higher (e.g. `1.0`) = more varied wording. Range `[0, 2]`. For Ollama it's threaded into `options.temperature`; for Gemini into `generationConfig.temperature`; for OpenAI-compatible providers (OpenAI/OpenRouter/DeepSeek/xAI/Custom) and Anthropic — into the top-level `temperature` field.

aracommit.general.maxDiffSize.markdownDescription:
Maximum diff size in characters sent to the LLM. Larger diffs are truncated with a `...(truncated)` marker. **Set to `-1` to disable truncation (sends the entire diff — only safe with long-context models).** Clamped to the range `[1000, 1000000]`.

**Tighten this for low-TPM free tiers:**
- **OpenRouter free (20 RPM / 50 RPD)** — `40000` typically fine.
- **Gemini / Anthropic / DeepSeek paid** — default `100000` is fine.

Rule of thumb: 1 token ≈ 4 chars, so `100000` chars ≈ 25000 tokens.

aracommit.apiRequestTimeout.markdownDescription: Timeout for LLM provider HTTP requests in seconds. **Set to `-1` for no timeout (infinite wait).**

aracommit.gitTimeout.markdownDescription: Timeout for `git` subprocesses (diff, blame, push, etc.) in seconds. Push over a slow remote or diff over a huge file may need more than the default. **Set to `-1` for no timeout.**

aracommit.general.maxOutputTokens.markdownDescription:
Maximum number of tokens the model may generate for one commit message, applied to every provider (Gemini `generationConfig.maxOutputTokens`, Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible `max_tokens`, Ollama `options.num_predict`).

A commit message is only ~40-60 tokens, so this is a runaway guard rather than a length limit. It must stay generous because **reasoning models bill their thinking against this same budget** — with too low a value the model spends the budget thinking and its answer is cut off mid-line. On truncation ARACommit retries with double the budget, up to `32768`.

aracommit.gemini.thinkingBudget.markdownDescription:
Thinking token budget for **Gemini 2.5** models. `0` disables thinking (fastest, cheapest, and plenty for commit messages), `-1` lets the model decide, any positive number caps it.

Ignored for Gemini 3.x (use `#aracommit.gemini.thinkingLevel#`) and for models without thinking support (Gemini 2.0 and older, Gemma). **Gemini 2.5 Pro cannot disable thinking** — a `0` here is raised to its minimum of `128`.

aracommit.gemini.thinkingLevel.markdownDescription:
Thinking depth for **Gemini 3.x** models, which cannot turn thinking off entirely. `low` is the default and is ample for commit messages; higher levels spend more tokens and time.

Ignored for Gemini 2.5 and older (use `#aracommit.gemini.thinkingBudget#`) — those models reject this field with HTTP 400.
